IONOS.summary_note: IONOS is a strong German cloud provider with genuine EU operational depth — the first German provider to hold both BSI C5 and IT-Grundschutz certifications, active in govdigital and GAIA-X, and a committed investor in EU cloud infrastructure. However, the decisive sovereignty weakness is the confirmed US CLOUD Act exposure through IONOS Inc. (Philadelphia, PA), which IONOS itself acknowledges in its published CLOUD Act white paper. This makes SOV-2 Q2 and Q3 both N — the most material disqualifier for high-sensitivity public sector workloads. United Internet's 63.8% majority ownership is EU-controlled (Ralph Dommermuth, German founder), but the Warburg Pincus (US PE) stake and public float introduce non-EU capital. Compared to fully independent German providers (noris network, Hetzner), IONOS carries a structural jurisdictional risk at the group level that cannot be mitigated contractually. Environmental performance is strong: 99.3% renewable energy (2024), published Sustainability Report, ISO 14001/50001 at 100% coverage, PUE 1.39.
